about: Cross-language pin for the empty-export rule (#7695, EXPORT-GEOM-9/15). Read by rust/export/tests/empty_export_parity.rs (the Rust exporters), scripts/lib/wasm-empty-export-contracts.mjs (the wasm entry points), packages/cli/src/commands/export.empty-model.test.ts (the CLI) and packages/export/src/zero-content.parity.test.ts (the TS policy split and content counters).

renderGeometry.exportable: a mesh the writer actually emits: after the caller's visibility filters and the writer's own emittable-mesh gate

data.exportable: a row, node, entity or room; zero of them is still a valid, schema-conformant empty document, reported through the format's own count

cases.name: no-products
cases.note: A project and its units, nothing else.

cases.name: data-only
cases.note: A contained wall with a property set and no representation: no render geometry, but real data.

cases.name: hello-wall
cases.note: A real model with render geometry: every format exports.

cases.name: hello-wall-isolated-to-nothing
cases.note: Geometry exists, but an ACTIVE empty isolation filter removes all of it. Only the formats that take an isolation set are listed; USD is whole-model.

legacyEmptyArtifacts.about: What main (9c26c31341) returned as success for the no-products case before #7695 (USD with the crate version replaced by a token). The TS content counters must read each as empty, so the CLI/MCP defense-in-depth checks stay in step with the Rust rule.
